answer_1.quote: We perform experiments on E2E dataset and 5 controllable generation tasks including Semantic Content, Parts-of-speech, Syntax Tree, Syntax Spans, and Length.

answer_2.quote: We use a teacher LM (i.e., a carefully fine-tuned GPT-2 model) and report the perplexity of generated text under the teacher LM. For every control task, we sample 200 control targets... and we generate 50 samples for each control target. We evaluate the accuracy of the generated sentence by examining the exact match rate... report the F1 scores... report the perplexity.

answer_4.quote: We then conduct human evaluation to evaluate the generated conversations qualitatively. We ask native speakers of English from Amazon Mechanical Turk to rank the quality of 50 generated sentences... annotators need to rank different system outputs based on the (i) fluency ... and (ii) the controllability ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank each generated sentence based on fluency and controllability.
